newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Jinqiao draws $1.6bln investment in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Jinqiao draws $1.6bln investment in 1996.

text.p: Shanghai's Jinqiao Export Processing Zone attracted $1.675 billion in investment in 1996, bringing total investment in the zone since its establishment in 1990 to $6.8 billion, a Jinqiao official said on Thursday.

In 1996, the zone's total industrial output was 15.4 billion yuan ($1.855 billion), up from 1995's 12.3 billion yuan, an official of the Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co, the developer of the zone, told Reuters.
Shanghai Jinqiao's 1996 net profits would be the same as in 1995, the official said, but he declined to give details before the release of his company's annual report.
All listed companies in China must issue annual reports by April 30. Profit and loss details cannot be revealed before then.
Shanghai Jinqiao posted net profits of 106 million yuan in 1995, down from 1994's 231 million yuan.
